snippet.title: Bones and Coins | Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Bones and Coins is an incremental dungeon crawler where you loot various coins and items. Build a synergized hero party, unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Explore new dungeon rooms filled with new enemies and drops.

Play now on Browser and Wishlist on Steam now!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134650/?utm_medium=Playtest&utm_campaign=Trailer&utm_source=Youtube
Itch.io Page: https://troyd-games.itch.io/bones-and-coins
